hero.title: Hidden Reports, Visible Art.
hero.subtitle: A prototype platform where encrypted whistleblower reports appear as abstract artworks. Only authorized reviewers with a secret key can decode the hidden messages.

text: Each artwork in the gallery may contain an encrypted report.
Reporters stay anonymous; only trusted reviewers with a secret key can read the full text.

ethics.heading: Ethics & Safety
body: This is a prototype, not a legal or emergency whistleblowing channel.
Do not use it to report life‑threatening situations or seek urgent help.
Not for planning crime, coordinating harm, or sharing illegal content.

footer.text: Hackathon prototype inspired by whistleblowing and steganography research. Not for production use.
